decisions.reason: Because submarine interior lighting is relatively distant from the core portfolio and likely serves a narrow niche, management would be more likely to reallocate resources if its results fall short of aspiration despite the firm's available slack.

This product fits the firm's industrial lighting strengths and the 2019 follow-up LED replacement kit suggests continued commitment and results at or near aspiration, so there is little reason for problemistic search.

The relaunch of a previously popular task light and its continued presentation indicate acceptable performance, and a large expanding firm can keep such a close-to-core product while it remains satisfactory.

A pendant office luminaire is closely aligned with the firm's established professional building offer and with growing demand for efficient LED office solutions, making retention more likely unless performance clearly disappoints.

Although a premium pendant luminaire may face tougher internal comparison and some overlap in the range, it is still close to the core business and an expanding large firm has enough slack to keep it unless results prove distinctly below aspiration.
